# CrossTab Studio — guide for AI agents and scripts

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_agents.py from the app's analysis registry. Do not edit by hand. App version 0.12.0. -->

CrossTab Studio is a survey-analysis app for Google Forms response CSVs (frequency tables, cross-tabulations, tests, regression, scales, figures and a written report). It runs entirely in the browser: R is executed with WebAssembly (webR), so **the data never leave the browser**.

This file explains how an AI agent or a script can drive the app and save a project file (`.prj`) and a PDF report. Everything goes through one JavaScript object, `window.CTS`, which calls the same functions as the on-screen buttons, so the numbers are identical to those produced by hand.

## What you need

- A real browser engine that runs JavaScript and WebAssembly (Chromium via Playwright, Puppeteer or Selenium; a browser-extension agent; or a person's browser). Reading the page as text is **not** enough: R only starts inside a browser.
- App URL: <https://okuyama23.github.io/crosstab-studio/>. The first load downloads about 22 MB (webR); later loads use the cache.
- Language of the screen and report: set `localStorage['cts-lang']` to `"ja"` (Japanese, default for Japanese browsers) or `"en"` **before** the page loads.
- Wait for the app with `await CTS.ready()` before anything else.

## Quick start (Playwright, Python)

```python
import asyncio, base64, json
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch()
        page = await browser.new_page()
        await page.add_init_script("localStorage.setItem('cts-lang', 'ja')")
        await page.goto("https://okuyama23.github.io/crosstab-studio/")
        await page.wait_for_function("window.CTS && CTS.ready")
        csv = open("responses.csv", encoding="utf-8-sig").read()
        spec = {
            "csv": csv, "name": "responses.csv", "title": "部活動とおこづかいの関係",
            "columns": [{"column": "1か月のおこづかい", "type": "ordinal"}],
            "invalidRows": [{"row": 201, "note": "金額が 1 億円"}],
            "analyses": [
                {"type": "chisq", "slots": {"a": "部活動", "b": "1か月のおこづかい"}},
                {"type": "mwu", "slots": {"g": "部活動", "y": "1か月のおこづかい"},
                 "choices": {"g": {"keep": ["運動部", "文化部"]}}},
            ],
            "output": {"prj": True, "pdf": True, "base64": True},
        }
        r = await page.evaluate("async (s) => { const r = await CTS.run(s); delete r.prj; delete r.pdf; return r; }", spec)
        open("project.prj", "wb").write(base64.b64decode(r["prjBase64"]))
        open("report.pdf", "wb").write(base64.b64decode(r["pdfBase64"]))
        print(json.dumps(r["results"], ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
        await browser.close()

asyncio.run(main())
```

`CTS.run` returns Blobs (`prj`, `pdf`), which cannot cross into Python, so ask for `base64: true` and delete the Blobs before returning, as above. In a browser-extension agent you can instead pass `download: true` to save the files through the browser's downloads.

## `CTS.run(spec)`

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `csv` | The response file: CSV text, a `Uint8Array`/`ArrayBuffer`, or a `Blob`/`File`. An Excel file (`.xlsx`) also works (first sheet). Omit it to keep the data already loaded. |
| `name` | File name used in the report (e.g., `"responses.csv"`). |
| `title` | Report title. |
| `columns` | Column settings applied before the analyses: `[{ column, type, delim, label, order, scoring }]` (see `CTS.setColumn`). |
| `invalidRows` | Rows to exclude from every analysis, the report, the Excel workbook and the R code. Row numbers start at 1 (the first response). Items are numbers or `{ row, note }`. |
| `flagRows` | Rows to flag (a marker only; they stay in the analyses). |
| `analyses` | List of analyses (see `CTS.addAnalysis`). The app holds at most 20 analyses. |
| `output` | `{ prj, pdf, docx, base64, download }`; default `{ prj: true, pdf: true }`. |
| `timeoutMs` | Time limit for the calculations (default 300000). |

It returns `{ ok, version, api, rows, invalid, analyses, results, prj, pdf, docx, prjBase64, pdfBase64, docxBase64 }`. `ok` is false when an analysis could not be calculated; its `message` says why (for example, too few responses).

## Step-by-step functions

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| `await CTS.ready()` | Waits until R has started and the analysis list is loaded. |
| `CTS.analyses()` | The analysis types with their slots and options (the catalogue below, in the screen language). |
| `await CTS.load(csv, name)` | Loads the responses as a new project (any open project is replaced). Returns `{ rows, columns }`. |
| `CTS.columns()` | The columns: `col` (number), `header` (question text), `label`, `type`, `n`, `options` (`value`, `n`) and, for numbers, `summary`. |
| `await CTS.setColumn(column, { type, delim, label, order, scoring })` | Changes a column. `type` is one of the types below; `order` lists option values from top to bottom; `scoring` is `"desc"` (default: top option = highest points), `"asc"`, or `{ mode: "custom", points: { value: points } }`. |
| `await CTS.markInvalid(rows, note)` / `CTS.unmarkInvalid(rows)` | Excludes rows from (or returns them to) all analyses. |
| `await CTS.markFlag(rows)` / `CTS.unmarkFlag(rows)` | Adds or removes flags. |
| `CTS.addAnalysis(spec)` | Adds one analysis and returns its id. |
| `CTS.removeAnalysis(id)` | Removes an analysis. |
| `await CTS.wait()` | Waits until every analysis is calculated and returns `CTS.results()`. |
| `CTS.results()` | Per analysis: `id`, `type`, `name`, `ok`, `message`, `test`, `p`, `significant`, `n`, `headline` (key values), `report` (the sentence for the report). |
| `CTS.prj()` | The project file as text (JSON). It contains the response data. |
| `await CTS.pdf()` / `await CTS.docx()` | The report as a PDF or Word Blob. |
| `CTS.reportText()` | The report as plain text. |
| `await CTS.toBase64(blobOrText)` / `CTS.download(blobOrText, name)` | Helpers for saving files. |

### Referring to columns

A column can be given as its number (`3`), its question text, or its display label. A unique beginning or a unique part of the text also works (`"部活動"`). If the text matches several columns, the call fails and lists them; then use the number. Use `CTS.columns()` to see what was detected.

### `CTS.addAnalysis(spec)`

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `type` | Analysis id from the catalogue (e.g., `"chisq"`). |
| `slots` | `{ slotId: column }`; for slots marked *many*, a list of columns. Each column must have one of the slot's allowed types; change the type with `setColumn` first if needed. |
| `options` | `{ optionId: value }` (see the catalogue). |
| `choices` | Per slot: `{ keep: [values], drop: [values], rename: { value: newName }, order: [values] }`. Options not kept are excluded from that analysis; options renamed to the same name are merged into one group. |
| `reverse` | For scale slots: columns to reverse-score. |
| `name` | Name shown in the app and the report. |
| `figure` | Figure settings, e.g. `{ kind: "group", orient: "v", value: "count", min: 0, max: 20000 }`. `kind`: `stack100`, `group`, `stack`, `heat`, `bar`, `line`, `pie`, `mean`, `coef`, `box`, `scatter`, `hist`, `map`, `cloud`, `wbar`, `net` (only those that suit the analysis are used). `orient`: `"h"`/`"v"`. `value`: `"pct"`/`"count"`. Axis range: `min`, `max`, `step` (value axis) and `xMin`, `xMax`, `xStep` (scatter x axis). Size: `w`, `h`. Colours: `palette` (`gray`, `blue`, `green`, `cud`, `viridis`, …). |
| `inReport` | `false` to leave the analysis out of the report. |

## Column types

| Type | 画面での名前 | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `nominal` | 単一回答 | single choice without order (e.g., gender, club) |
| `ordinal` | 順序あり | single choice with ordered levels (e.g., agree … disagree, grade) |
| `multi` | 複数回答 | multiple choice, “select all that apply” |
| `numeric` | 数値 | numbers (age, hours, yen) |
| `time` | 日時 | timestamps |
| `text` | 使わない | free text; not used by most analyses (text mining uses it) |

## Analysis catalogue

Slot types say which column types each slot accepts. *many* slots take two or more columns; *optional* slots may be omitted.

### Tabulation（集計）

#### `freq` — Frequency table（単純集計）

Counts and percentages for each option of one question. Also works for multiple-choice questions.

| Slot | Label | 画面の名前 | Types | Many | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `a` | Question to tabulate | 集計する質問 | nominal, ordinal, multi |  |  |

| Option | Kind | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gof` | check | `false` | `true`, `false` | Test whether responses are uneven (goodness-of-fit test) |

#### `freqmulti` — Frequencies of multiple questions（複数の設問の単純集計）

Tabulates several questions that share the same options (e.g., frequency of use for each service) side by side, with one color per question in the chart.

| Slot | Label | 画面の名前 | Types | Many | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | Questions to compare (same options) | 比べる設問（同じ選択肢） | nominal, ordinal | yes |  |

| Option | Kind | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `friedman` | check | `false` | `true`, `false` | Compare response tendencies across questions (Friedman test) |

#### `numsum` — Numeric summary and histogram（数値の要約とヒストグラム）

Gives the mean, SD, median and frequency distribution of a numeric question (age, time, counts, etc.) with a histogram. Can also compare groups.

| Slot | Label | 画面の名前 | Types | Many | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `y` | Numeric question | 数値の質問 | numeric, ordinal |  |  |
| `g` | Groups (optional) | グループ（任意） | nominal, ordinal |  | yes |

| Option | Kind | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bins` | select | `"auto"` | `auto`, `sturges`, `fd`, `int` | Histogram bins |

#### `timeline` — Response timeline（回答日時の推移）

Counts responses and cumulative totals per day, week or month from the timestamp. Used to check how responses came in.

| Slot | Label | 画面の名前 | Types | Many | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `t` | Date-time column | 日時の列 | time |  |  |

| Option | Kind | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `per` | select | `"day"` | `day`, `week`, `month` | Group by |

### Association between two questions（2 つの質問の関連）

#### `chisq` — Chi-square test（カイ二乗検定）

Tests whether the answers to two questions are associated. The basic test for a cross-tabulation.

| Slot | Label | 画面の名前 | Types | Many | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `a` | Rows (groups to compare) | 行（比べるグループ） | nominal, ordinal |  |  |
| `b` | Columns (responses) | 列（回答） | nominal, ordinal |  |  |

| Option | Kind | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `yates` | check | `false` | `true`, `false` | Use Yates' correction (2×2 tables) |
| `residMode` | select | `"z"` | `z`, `bonf` | Criterion for residuals |

#### `fisher` — Fisher's exact test（フィッシャーの正確確率検定）

A test of association for tables with cells that have few respondents. Also gives the odds ratio for 2×2 tables.

| Slot | Label | 画面の名前 | Types | Many | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `a` | Rows (groups to compare) | 行（比べるグループ） | nominal, ordinal |  |  |
| `b` | Columns (responses) | 列（回答） | nominal, ordinal |  |  |

| Option | Kind | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `residMode` | select | `"z"` | `z`, `bonf` | Criterion for residuals |

#### `trend` — Trend test for proportions (Cochran–Armitage)（割合の傾向検定（コクラン・アーミテージ））

Tests whether the proportion of “yes” consistently increases (or decreases) as the level rises.

| Slot | Label | 画面の名前 | Types | Many | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `b` | Two-option response | 2 択の回答 | nominal, ordinal |  |  |
| `o` | Levels (ordinal) | 段階（順序あり） | ordinal |  |  |

#### `strat` — Stratified cross-tabulation (CMH test)（層別のクロス集計（CMH 検定））

Splits the cross-tabulation into strata by a third question (e.g., grade) and tests whether the two questions are associated after adjusting for the strata (Cochran–Mantel–Haenszel test).

| Slot | Label | 画面の名前 | Types | Many | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `a` | Rows (groups to compare) | 行（比べるグループ） | nominal, ordinal |  |  |
| `b` | Columns (responses) | 列（回答） | nominal, ordinal |  |  |
| `z` | Strata (question to split by) | 層（分けて見る質問） | nominal, ordinal |  |  |

### Comparing ordinal responses（順序のある回答の比較）

#### `mwu` — Mann–Whitney U test（マン・ホイットニーの U 検定）

Tests whether responses on an ordinal scale (e.g., agree to disagree) differ between two groups.

| Slot | Label | 画面の名前 | Types | Many | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `g` | Groups (2 groups) | グループ（2 群） | nominal, ordinal |  |  |
| `y` | Response to compare (ordinal) | 比べる回答（順序あり） | ordinal, numeric |  |  |

#### `kw` — Kruskal–Wallis test（クラスカル・ウォリス検定）

Tests whether responses on an ordinal scale differ among three or more groups. Also shows which pairs differ.

| Slot | Label | 画面の名前 | Types | Many | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `g` | Groups (3 or more) | グループ（3 群以上） | nominal, ordinal |  |  |
| `y` | Response to compare (ordinal) | 比べる回答（順序あり） | ordinal, numeric |  |  |

#### `spearman` — Spearman's rank correlation（スピアマンの順位相関）

Tests whether two ordinal responses are related so that when one is higher, the other is also higher (or lower).

| Slot | Label | 画面の名前 | Types | Many | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | Response 1 (ordinal) | 回答 1（順序あり） | ordinal, numeric |  |  |
| `y` | Response 2 (ordinal) | 回答 2（順序あり） | ordinal, numeric |  |  |

### Multiple choice（複数回答）

#### `multi` — Multiple-choice cross-tabulation（複数回答のクロス集計）

For “select all that apply” questions, compares the proportion choosing each option between groups.

| Slot | Label | 画面の名前 | Types | Many | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `m` | Multiple-choice question | 複数回答の質問 | multi |  |  |
| `g` | Groups | グループ | nominal, ordinal |  |  |

### Two responses from the same people（同じ人の 2 つの回答）

#### `wsr` — Wilcoxon signed-rank test（ウィルコクソンの符号付順位検定）

Compares two questions answered with the same options (e.g., frequency of use of two services) within the same respondents.

| Slot | Label | 画面の名前 | Types | Many | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | Response 1 (ordinal) | 回答 1（順序あり） | ordinal |  |  |
| `y` | Response 2 (same options) | 回答 2（同じ選択肢） | ordinal |  |  |

#### `mcnemar` — McNemar's test（マクネマー検定）

Compares two yes/no questions within the same respondents (e.g., are there many who said “yes” to A but “no” to B?).

| Slot | Label | 画面の名前 | Types | Many | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | Response 1 (two options) | 回答 1（2 択） | nominal, ordinal |  |  |
| `y` | Response 2 (same two options) | 回答 2（同じ 2 択） | nominal, ordinal |  |  |

### Comparing means（平均の比較）

#### `ttest` — t-test (comparing two means)（t 検定（2 群の平均の比較））

Tests whether the mean of a numeric value (or ordinal score) differs between two groups. Also gives the effect size and the confidence interval of the difference.

| Slot | Label | 画面の名前 | Types | Many | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `g` | Groups (2 groups) | グループ（2 群） | nominal, ordinal |  |  |
| `y` | Value to compare | 比べる値 | numeric, ordinal |  |  |

| Option | Kind | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `student` | check | `false` | `true`, `false` | Assume equal variances (Student's t-test) |

#### `anova` — One-way ANOVA (comparing three or more means)（一元配置分散分析（3 群以上の平均の比較））

Tests whether the mean of a numeric value (or ordinal score) differs among three or more groups, and shows which pairs differ.

| Slot | Label | 画面の名前 | Types | Many | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `g` | Groups (3 or more) | グループ（3 群以上） | nominal, ordinal |  |  |
| `y` | Value to compare | 比べる値 | numeric, ordinal |  |  |

| Option | Kind | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `classic` | check | `false` | `true`, `false` | Assume equal variances (standard ANOVA and Tukey method) |

#### `pairedt` — Paired t-test（対応のある t 検定）

Tests whether the means of two values answered by the same respondents (before and after, scores of two items, etc.) differ.

| Slot | Label | 画面の名前 | Types | Many | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | Value 1 | 値 1 | numeric, ordinal |  |  |
| `y` | Value 2 | 値 2 | numeric, ordinal |  |  |

### Association and correlation（関連・相関）

#### `pearson` — Pearson's correlation coefficient（ピアソンの相関係数）

Measures the strength of the linear association between two numeric values (or ordinal scores) and draws a scatter plot with a regression line.

| Slot | Label | 画面の名前 | Types | Many | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | Value 1 (horizontal axis) | 値 1（横軸） | numeric, ordinal |  |  |
| `y` | Value 2 (vertical axis) | 値 2（縦軸） | numeric, ordinal |  |  |

### Scales and multivariate（尺度・多変量）

#### `alpha` — Scale reliability (α and ω coefficients)（尺度の信頼性（α 係数・ω 係数））

Examines the internal consistency of several ordinal questions measuring the same construct (a scale) with α and ω coefficients, and shows item-level problems such as means, ceiling and floor effects, and item–total correlations.

| Slot | Label | 画面の名前 | Types | Many | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | Scale items (same options) | 尺度の項目（同じ選択肢） | ordinal | yes |  |

#### `factor` — Exploratory factor analysis（探索的因子分析）

Looks for common underlying factors behind many ordinal questions. Used to develop questionnaire scales.

| Slot | Label | 画面の名前 | Types | Many | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | Items to analyze (same options) | 分析する項目（同じ選択肢） | ordinal | yes |  |

| Option | Kind | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `nf` | select | `"auto"` | `auto`, `1`, `2`, `3`, `4`, `5` | Number of factors |
| `rotation` | select | `"promax"` | `promax`, `varimax` | Rotation |

#### `ca` — Correspondence analysis（コレスポンデンス分析）

Summarizes the cross-tabulation of two questions with many options as a single map in which options with similar response patterns are placed close together.

| Slot | Label | 画面の名前 | Types | Many | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `a` | Question 1 (rows) | 質問 1（行） | nominal, ordinal |  |  |
| `b` | Question 2 (columns) | 質問 2（列） | nominal, ordinal |  |  |

#### `cfa` — Confirmatory factor analysis（確認的因子分析）

Tests whether a predefined grouping of items into factors fits the data. Gives fit indices (CFI, RMSEA, etc.), factor loadings and reliability by factor.

| Slot | Label | 画面の名前 | Types | Many | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `f1` | Items of factor 1 | 因子 1 の項目 | ordinal | yes |  |
| `f2` | Items of factor 2 | 因子 2 の項目 | ordinal | yes | yes |
| `f3` | Items of factor 3 | 因子 3 の項目 | ordinal | yes | yes |
| `f4` | Items of factor 4 | 因子 4 の項目 | ordinal | yes | yes |

### Free text（自由記述）

#### `textmine` — Text mining (free text)（テキストマイニング（自由記述））

Splits free-text responses into words and examines frequent words, words used together (co-occurrence network), and words used more often by each group.

| Slot | Label | 画面の名前 | Types | Many | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `t` | Free-text question | 自由記述の質問 | text, nominal |  |  |
| `g` | Groups (optional) | グループ（任意） | nominal, ordinal |  | yes |

| Option | Kind | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `top` | select | `"60"` | `30`, `60`, `100` | Number of words to extract |
| `minf` | select | `"2"` | `1`, `2`, `3`, `5`, `10` | Minimum occurrences of a word (responses) |
| `edges` | select | `"60"` | `30`, `60`, `100` | Number of lines in the co-occurrence network |
| `compound` | check | `true` | `true`, `false` | Join consecutive kanji / katakana words (e.g., 自然 + 環境 → 自然環境) |
| `stop` | text | `""` |  | Words to exclude (separated by commas) |

### Regression analysis（回帰分析）

#### `reg` — Multiple regression analysis（重回帰分析）

Explains or predicts a numeric value (or ordinal score) from several questions. Gives the influence of each independent variable (standardized coefficient β) and the explanatory power of the whole model (R²).

| Slot | Label | 画面の名前 | Types | Many | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `y` | Dependent variable (value to explain) | 目的変数（説明したい値） | numeric, ordinal |  |  |
| `x` | Independent variables (select several) | 説明変数（複数選べます） | numeric, ordinal, nominal | yes |  |

#### `logit` — Logistic regression analysis（ロジスティック回帰分析）

Explains or predicts a two-option response (e.g., whether the student belongs to a club) from several questions. Gives the odds ratio for each independent variable.

| Slot | Label | 画面の名前 | Types | Many | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `y` | Dependent variable (two-option response) | 目的変数（2 択の回答） | nominal, ordinal |  |  |
| `x` | Independent variables (select several) | 説明変数（複数選べます） | numeric, ordinal, nominal | yes |  |

## Notes

- **Same results as the screen.** `CTS` uses the app's own functions; the analyses, report sentences, figures and files are the same as when a person makes them. The calculations were checked against R and Python reference implementations (see the paper in preparation).
- **Stability.** `CTS.apiVersion` is `1`. Function names and spec fields listed here are kept; new fields may be added. Internal functions under `window.App` may change without notice; do not use them.
- **Errors.** Wrong column names, types, slots, options or option values throw an `Error` whose message lists the valid choices. A failed `addAnalysis` leaves the project unchanged.
- **Privacy.** The `.prj` file and the PDF contain the responses or summaries of them. Handle them as the survey's consent allows.
- **Opening the results.** A person can open the `.prj` in the app (File → Open) to see and edit everything that was made.
- **Citation.** Okuyama, T. CrossTab Studio (Version 0.12.0) [Computer software]. https://okuyama23.github.io/crosstab-studio/
